# Example file

`stoney_depth.tif` is a 100 m depth raster of Stoney Lake, Ontario, derived
from the bathymetry made before 2024. It has the same grid and depths as
`depth_raster` of positionR 1.7.0, with the CRS set to EPSG:32617 (UTM zone
17N on WGS 84). Depth is zero or negative metres and land is `NA`.
4,818 cells are water, and 56 of them hold 0. The app opens on this raster
when no other study area is given. detfield and arraydesign include the same
file.
